title: Computed Setters
description: Learn how to create writable computed properties with getters and setters.

slides.title: Writable Computed Properties
Example: Full Name Editor
slides.content: A component where you can edit the full name, and it updates the first and last names:
slides.codeSnippet: First: {{ firstName }} | Last: {{ lastName }}

slides.title: When to Use Setters
slides.content:
Computed setters are great for creating a simplified interface to a complex data model. For example:
- A date picker that sets separate year/month/day fields.
- A color picker that sets RGB values from a hex string.

They keep your template clean and your logic centralized.

quizData.question: How do you make a computed property writable?

options.text: Use a setter function inside the computed property
You cannot make computed properties writable

quizData.explanation: You define a computed property as an object with `get` and `set` methods. The setter is called when the property is assigned a new value.
